hero.subtitle: Own a real farming plot in Armenia. A local farmer tends it. Watch it grow from anywhere in the world — and at harvest, decide what happens to it.

problem.heading: The land doesn't disappear. The connection does.

cards.title: Your children have never seen it
cards.description: Growing up abroad means Armenia stays abstract — a word, a story, a photograph. Without something real to point to, the homeland fades with each generation.

cards.title: Every visit feels like the first time
cards.description: You love it but you don't belong to it. There's no anchor — no plot of land, no corner of Armenia that is yours to return to every season.

cards.title: You can't give roots you don't hold
cards.description: You want to pass something real to the next generation. But without a living, tangible tie to the land, there's nothing concrete to hand down.

howItWorks.heading: Four steps to owning a piece of Armenia.
howItWorks.intro: No travel required. No farming experience. Just a real plot with your name on it.

steps.title: Choose your plot in Armenia
steps.description: Browse plots in Armenian farming regions. Pick your preferred size and what grows on it — tomatoes, cucumbers, herbs, leafy greens.

steps.title: Your farmer tends it
steps.description: A real on-the-ground farmer handles everything — soil, planting, irrigation, care. Weekly photo updates show exactly what's happening on your plot.

steps.title: Watch your plot grow
steps.description: Live status, farmer diary updates, harvest notifications. Follow every stage of the season from anywhere in the world on your personal dashboard.

steps.title: Decide what happens at harvest
steps.description: Reinvest it into next season, donate to a local Armenian family, convert to account credit, or gift the value to someone who deserves a piece of the Highland.

harvestOptions.heading: What happens at harvest time.
harvestOptions.intro: Diaspora plots don't ship physically in Phase 1. Four options let you put your harvest to meaningful use.

options.title: Reinvest
options.description: Put the harvest value back into your plot. Expand it, add a new crop variety, or grow it toward next season.

options.title: Donate
options.description: Your harvest goes to a local Armenian family in need. You receive a photo of the delivery as proof of impact.

options.title: Sell & Hold Credit
options.description: We convert your harvest to account credit. Use it next season, upgrade your plot, or carry it forward indefinitely.

options.title: Gift Card
options.description: Turn your harvest value into a Hyeland gift. A plot for a family member, a friend — anyone who deserves a piece of the Highland.

dashboardShowcase.heading: Your plot, in your pocket.
dashboardShowcase.intro: Watch every stage of your season from wherever you are. Your farmer updates it. You follow along.
features: Live photos from your plot, posted by your farmer
Farmer diary — seasonal notes, weather reports, growth milestones
Harvest notifications when your crops are ready
One-tap harvest option selection — reinvest, donate, gift, or hold credit
Season timeline and estimated harvest weight

ownership.heading: Your name. Your plot. Your Armenia.
ownership.intro: This isn't symbolic. Your plot has coordinates, a farmer, and a record. You own a specific piece of land — not a share of a basket.

items.title: Named and registered
items.description: Your plot is registered to you by name. You receive the exact GPS coordinates and a plot reference number.

items.title: Photo evidence every week
items.description: Your farmer documents every stage — planting, first shoots, flowering, harvest. You see it as it happens.

items.title: Legal accountability
items.description: Your farmer agreement covers the full season. If something goes wrong, we tell you first — no surprises.

items.title: Transferable legacy
items.description: A Hyeland plot can be gifted, passed down, or extended into a family holding across multiple seasons.

giftMechanic.heading: Give someone roots.
giftMechanic.intro: A Hyeland plot is the only gift that keeps a living connection to Armenia. Give one to a parent in Yerevan, a child growing up abroad, or a friend who misses home.
features: Choose a plot and crop type on their behalf
A personalised gift confirmation sent to them by email
They get their own dashboard to watch the plot grow
At harvest, they choose what happens to it
giftMechanic.note: Use your harvest credit, or purchase a gift plot directly.

progress.heading: We're building this in public.
progress.intro: We're at the beginning. Here's where we are, and where we're going.

farmer.name: Aram Mkrtchyan
farmer.quote: Every plot I tend has a name behind it. Someone far away is watching. I take that seriously.
farmer.bio: Aram manages plots in the Armavir region — one of Armenia's most fertile valleys. He tends dozens of individual plots and treats each one as his own. When you're across the world wondering about your land, it's Aram who's there — planting, watering, documenting, and caring for it season after season.

seasonal.heading: Four seasons of real Armenian produce.
seasonal.intro: These are the crops growing on your plot across the year. You'll see them at every stage — from first shoots to full harvest.

trust.heading: What Phase 1 means for diaspora.
trust.intro: We're being clear about what this is. Phase 1 diaspora plots come with honest constraints — and real value.

points.title: No physical shipping in Phase 1
points.description: Diaspora plots don't ship produce during Phase 1. All harvest value is handled through our four digital options: reinvest, donate, sell & hold credit, or gift.

points.title: Limited to 20 diaspora plots
points.description: The pre-pilot is capped at 20 diaspora plots globally. Early members directly shape what Phase 2 looks like.

points.title: Armavir region only
points.description: All Phase 1 plots are in the Armavir valley. Additional regions open in Phase 2 as we grow the farmer network.

points.title: You're a founding member, not a customer
points.description: Pre-pilot members have direct access to us. Your feedback on the product, the harvest options, and the experience shapes every decision we make.

phaseTwo.heading: Physical shipping is on the roadmap.
phaseTwo.body: We're building toward direct delivery from your plot to your door — wherever you are in the world. This isn't available yet in Phase 1, but it's the direction we're heading. Pre-pilot diaspora members will be first in line.

items.question: Can I visit my plot in Armenia?
items.answer: Yes. Your plot has exact GPS coordinates. You're welcome to visit during any of your trips to Armenia — just let us know in advance and Aram will show you around. We'd love for you to see it in person.

items.question: What happens to my harvest — do I have to decide in advance?
items.answer: No. We notify you when your harvest is ready and give you time to choose. You pick one of the four options — reinvest, donate, sell & hold credit, or gift — directly from your dashboard. You can change your mind up until the harvest date.

items.question: Can I gift a plot to someone as a present?
items.answer: Yes — and it's one of our favourite use cases. You can gift a plot to anyone: a parent in Armenia, a sibling abroad, or a friend who wants a living connection to the land. They get their own dashboard and choose what happens to their harvest.

items.question: Is this a one-time purchase or a subscription?
items.answer: It's seasonal. You pay per growing season. At the end of each season you can renew, expand, or let the plot go. There's no automatic renewal — we ask you each time.

items.question: Will physical delivery to my country ever be available?
items.answer: Yes — that's Phase 2. We're working toward it but it's not available yet. We won't promise a date, but diaspora pre-pilot members will be first to access it when it launches.

items.question: Can I own more than one plot?
items.answer: In Phase 1 we're limiting it to one plot per person to keep the pre-pilot manageable. Once we expand in Phase 2, you'll be able to hold multiple plots or build a family holding.

about.name: Aleksandr Melikyan
about.paragraph1: I've spent nine years building software products. In 2022 I started hiking in the Armenian mountains — Aragats, Geghama, Khustup. Something shifted.
about.paragraph2: I kept thinking about the gap between the land I was walking on and the people who should feel connected to it — both those living in Armenia and those living far from it. Hyeland is my attempt to close that gap.
about.paragraph3: I'm building this publicly, slowly, and honestly. The pre-pilot is how I test whether the idea is real. If you're reading this, you're early — and that matters.

ctaFooter.heading: Own a piece of the Highland.
ctaFooter.subtitle: Phase 1 is limited to 20 diaspora plots. No payment yet — just register your interest and we'll reach out directly.
ctaFooter.note: No payment required to register. We'll contact you personally.
